item.title: Show HN: Is this AI training on my prompts? A dated record of the fine print
Show HN: Wy – a Rust terminal tool for understanding AI-generated code
item.description:
I have been an opensource terminal tool for understanding AI-generated code.

A git-diff shows what changed, but the context behind it lives somewhere within the agent's session context, and often goes missing in long running agent execution.

Wy helps reduce that understanding gap, and helps engineers build judgement. This is especially useful for unfamiliar codebases, where agents are the primary interface for the developers.

It is meant to be used alongside the

With wy, you can:

- Browse changes, and relevant agent notes in a terminal UI

- Request explanation and ask follow up questions and changes

- Open code references and citations

- Distinguish recorded justifications agents derived to get a better understanding of the changes.

If you try, and find it useful consider supporting it with a github star or bug report or contribution.
